comment: THE RIFT v3 (sl-0115, prototype #2): the arena where the bait fighter fights the catch, resized to the 50/50 split. 12x13 grid; INTERIOR 10x11 tiles = 320x352 px = the right pane at 1:1 base scale (Law 1 by construction: the fixed rift camera frames the interior, the wall ring sits exactly off-pane, bullets die at the pane edge like the prototype's cull). Prototype fighting space was 300x340 px - this is its tile-snapped match. Two 1x1 star-rock stubs (solid, shot-blocking, prototype-placed class); the wall ring renders off-camera so the galaxy backdrop is the only dressing that shows (view-side, per-biome). Quiet dark floor under the backdrop (Law 6).
